Hello, I’m Wuraola Odunewu.

I’m a Virtual Administrative & Operations Support professional with experience in business administration, client coordination, documentation, customer communication and HR-related support.

My background includes working with a travel and study-abroad support company, providing administrative support to a professional association, and contributing to HR administration through volunteer roles.

Through these experiences, I’ve developed a practical understanding of the work that keeps a business running behind the scenes, from maintaining organised records and managing documentation to coordinating activities, tracking tasks and ensuring important follow-ups are not overlooked.

I also use digital tools such as Airtable, Notion, HubSpot CRM, Google Workspace and Canva to organise information, manage administrative workflows and support day-to-day business activities.

I enjoy bringing structure to everyday work, keeping information organised and helping teams stay on top of their responsibilities. I approach every assignment with attention to detail, clear communication, accountability and a willingness to understand each business's needs before providing support.

My goal is simple: to help growing businesses stay organised, manage their daily operations more effectively and spend more time focusing on the work that moves their business forward.

Practical support for the work that keeps your business moving.

I provide administrative, customer support and operational assistance to growing businesses. Whether it’s keeping business records organised, managing customer enquiries or coordinating everyday tasks, I help ensure important activities receive the attention they need.
